fusions.name: Long Stillness, One Strike
fusions.desc: Strikes from stillness at an enemy up to 5 tiles away, which deals 28 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Chill That Settles
fusions.desc: Lets the cold in your blood settle over the ground, which deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1 second. They are [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Mending
fusions.desc: Restores 20 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Sunned Shell
fusions.desc: By day, your armour rises by 12%.
